contract.spatial_rule: GAEZ cell-center POWER point; area-mean SoilGrids over label cell

environmental_manifest_notice: Full environmental object manifest retained with local complete evaluation and authentic restored dataset; this review snapshot omits that repeated list.
limitations: Approximates a modeled GAEZ assessment, not observed farm success.
POWER and GAEZ AgERA5 are different climate products despite aligned years.
Coarse regional climate and ~10 km labels do not establish field precision.
0–5 cm modeled soil is not a laboratory test or a full root-zone profile.
Coverage screening is conservative and is not a complete Phase 5 reliability system.
No confidence percentage, yield, management benefit or rotation advice is provided.

source_manifest.attribution: FAO and IIASA (2025), GAEZ v5 suitability index; subset/processing by Field Shift

target.meaning: Approximation of FAO/IIASA GAEZ v5 modeled all-land suitability index
